title: Add the reviewer user manual
summary: Explain the local review app and its complete human review workflow in plain language.
rationale: The protocol documents are implementation-facing; a reviewer unfamiliar with the project needs one task-oriented entry point.

decisions.summary: Organize the manual around reviewer tasks rather than artifact internals.
decisions.rationale: A new user needs to start the app, understand a stage, comment, review fixes, and approve; schemas and CLI implementation details are not required for those tasks.

decisions.summary: State current POC limitations in the manual.
decisions.rationale: Users need to know that feedback is local, stages use separate cumulative branches, remote hosting is outside the protocol, and approval publishes metadata separately.

validation.summary: The manual follows the current UI labels from startup through review, feedback, resolution approval, and whole-stack approval, and its linked files exist.
validation.command: git diff --check and local link target check
